question.name: CSEC Chem Jan 2023 Q1b(i) — Titration Data Table
question.text:
A titration was performed using dilute sulfuric acid (4.9 g dm⁻³) from a burette against sodium hydroxide solution in a conical flask, with methyl orange indicator.

The burette readings from Figure 1 are summarised below. Read each diagram carefully and complete the table.

Burette Reading / cm³Titration 1 (Rough)Titration 2Titration 3
Final reading(T1 final)(T2 final)(T3 final)
Initial reading(T1 initial)(T2 initial)(T3 initial)
Volume of acid used(T1 volume)(T2 volume)(T3 volume)

Burette readings from Figure 1:
Titration 1: Initial = 0.5 cm³, Final = 25.5 cm³
Titration 2: Initial = 12.2 cm³, Final = 37.2 cm³
Titration 3: Initial = 15.5 cm³, Final = 40.5 cm³
question.general_feedback:
Complete table:

Burette Reading / cm³Titration 1Titration 2Titration 3
Final reading25.537.240.5
Initial reading0.512.215.5
Volume of acid used25.025.025.0

Volumes are all 25.0 cm³ — Titrations 2 and 3 are concordant (within 0.1 cm³ of each other) and are used for the average.

Key skill: Read from the bottom of the meniscus. Burette markings increase downward, so final reading > initial reading.

steps.label:
Burette reading rule: Always read from the bottom of the meniscus. Burette numbers increase downward — the final reading is always greater than the initial reading.
Volume formula: Volume used = Final reading − Initial reading
Record the final burette readings for all three titrations. (3 marks)
Record the initial burette readings for all three titrations. (3 marks)
Calculate the volume of acid used (final − initial) for each titration. (3 marks)

fields.label: Titration 1 — Final reading = _____ cm³
fields.diagnostic_hint: Titration 1 final: the meniscus is exactly halfway between 25 and 26 = 25.5 cm³

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Read from the BOTTOM of the meniscus. The final reading for Titration 1 is halfway between 25 and 26 = 25.5 cm³. Remember burette numbers increase going down.

fields.label: Titration 2 — Final reading = _____ cm³
fields.diagnostic_hint: Titration 2 final: the meniscus is two small increments below 37 = 37.2 cm³

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Each small division on a burette = 0.1 cm³. Two increments below 37 means 37 + 0.2 = 37.2 cm³.

fields.label: Titration 3 — Final reading = _____ cm³
fields.diagnostic_hint: Titration 3 final: the meniscus is halfway between 40 and 41 = 40.5 cm³

fields.label: Titration 1 — Initial reading = _____ cm³
fields.diagnostic_hint: Titration 1 initial: the meniscus is halfway between 0 and 1 = 0.5 cm³

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: The initial reading for Titration 1 is halfway between 0 and 1 = 0.5 cm³.

fields.label: Titration 2 — Initial reading = _____ cm³
fields.diagnostic_hint: Titration 2 initial: the meniscus is two small increments below 12 = 12.2 cm³

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Two small divisions (each 0.1 cm³) below 12 = 12.2 cm³.

fields.label: Titration 3 — Initial reading = _____ cm³
fields.diagnostic_hint: Titration 3 initial: the meniscus is halfway between 15 and 16 = 15.5 cm³

fields.label: Titration 1 — Volume of acid used = _____ cm³

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Volume = Final reading − Initial reading = 25.5 − 0.5 = 25.0 cm³.
